claim: Provisional CP24 child evidence: gem5 contains a shared generic-dispatch route policy and owner-bound MessageType 18 bridge handler, while the runtime adds an opt-in endpoint handshake probe. A live runtime-to-gem5 socket probe proves the production daemon omits capability bit 8 and returns the canonical UnsupportedCapability handshake path. The evidence does not prove a MessageType 18 daemon route, positive generic negotiation, or execution.
command_argv: cp24_live_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cp24-evidence.XXXXXX); endpoint_path="$cp24_live_dir/bridge.sock"; projects/gem5/build/VEGA_X86/gem5.opt --listener-mode=on -d "$cp24_live_dir/out" projects/gem5/configs/example/gemsim/host_bridge.py --endpoint "$endpoint_path" --epoch 1 --startup-timeout-ms 10000 --run-timeout-ms 10000 >"$cp24_live_dir/gem5.stdout" 2>"$cp24_live_dir/gem5.stderr" & gem5_pid=$!; for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do test -S "$endpoint_path" && break; kill -0 "$gem5_pid" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done; test -S "$endpoint_path" || { wait "$gem5_pid" || true; exit 1; }; SAGR_GENERIC_BRIDGE_ENDPOINT="$endpoint_path" /tmp/cp24-runtime-check/tests/self_amdgpu_runtime_generic_dispatch_v2_endpoint_test; probe_rc=$?; kill "$gem5_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$gem5_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; exit "$probe_rc"

The gem5 route harness exercises shared policy/codec helpers, not HostGPUBridge's live Unix socket or a negotiated positive session.

The environment-gated CTest instance skipped because SAGR_GENERIC_BRIDGE_ENDPOINT was unset; a separate retained live probe reached VEGA_X86 gem5 and proved only the negative capability handshake, not a MessageType 18 request or route.
The sealed-FD H2D carrier is proven by the existing runtime mock client test, not by a gem5 daemon route.
The 4K/64K ALLOC restriction is a daemon-handler policy gate; the CP23 protocol and local native adapter still represent logical alignment 8.
No SUBMIT success ACK, type-20 completion, queue/signal/tick identity, launcher, compiler/JIT, GPUDispatcher/CU, output, or fallback claim is made.
